_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 0 of 35 12h windows producing a ±2pt score move over the last 7 days, the statistically honest call is HOLD on the phase ladder — the coil persists until the analyst's named breaker (funding >0.01% + exchange reserves <85) fires to confirm spot-driven accumulation.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial split — both see eventual UP resolution toward Hope, but analyst explicitly hedges with low conviction and demands confirmation signals before committing directionally, while narrative leans more confidently into the wall-of-worry climb
next_move.confirmed_if: funding rises above 0.01% AND btc_exchange_reserves_pct_30d drops below 85 within 48h, confirming spot accumulation absorbing ETF inflows
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 20 OR fed_liquidity stays pinned at 0 while BTC breaks below $62k, showing risk-off despite structural ETF demand
